summary_1line: Nahusha becomes king of the gods, indulges in pleasure, lusts after Indra’s wife Sachi, and Vrihaspati refuses to surrender her despite pressure.

image_candidates.scene_text: Nahusha sits enthroned amid celestial nymphs in the Nandana grove while Gandharvas play music and cool fragrant winds swirl around him.
The frightened queen Sachi stands before the sage Vrihaspati, pleading for protection from the newly crowned god-king Nahusha.
Nahusha, angered and arrogant on his heavenly throne, demands that Indra’s queen be brought to him despite the gods’ warnings.
